data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 3.4m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2021: deterioration of GBP 8.2m). In 2022, there has been an overall deficit in ultimate claims of GBP 1.7m (2021: deficit of GBP 15.8m) due primarily to an increase in claims estimates.

named_events.loss_description: The syndicate has material exposure to Hurricane Ian. The current ultimate estimated losses for Hurricane Ian are gross and net $48.5m.
For Ida, we are projecting ultimate gross losses of $37.3m, of which $33.7m had been incurred at year end.
For those Uri policies that fall to the 2021 year, we are projecting $4.5m, of which $4.1m had been incurred at year end.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 gross claims outstanding were GBP 28.976m. During 2022 there was an adverse prior-year development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 3.3m (c.11.4% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse claims development and increased claims estimates on prior underwriting years (principally reflected in the 2020 underwriting year). The syndicate cites a deterioration on prior years of GBP 3.4m (net) and an overall increase in ultimate claims estimates; named catastrophe activity in 2022 (notably Hurricane Ian) is reported separately and affected current-year outcomes.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provisions for claims includes a deterioration of GBP 3.4m in respect of reserves set in prior years (2021: deterioration of GBP 8.2m).
In 2022, there has been an overall deficit in ultimate claims of GBP 1.7m (2021: deficit of GBP 15.8m) due primarily to an increase in claims estimates.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column (1 Jan 2022). Prior-year development (gross) computed from the gross claims development triangle (comparison of 2020 column current estimate vs prior diagonal 24-month estimate). The report also states a net prior-year deterioration (GBP 3.4m) - net figures quoted in the notes; gross triangle yields ~GBP 3.313m. Some named event losses are quoted in USD in the text and have not been converted to GBP; no explicit gross prior-year movement line in the notes (gross) other than the triangle, so triangle was used as primary source for gross PYD.
